description: 北九州市 社会資本総合整備計画書(道路整備事業等) [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 北九州市. 国土交通省「社会資本整備総合交付金」を活用した道路整備事業等に関する政策の計画目標や要素事業の事業実施期間等をまとめたものです。. Coverage: 北九州市. The portal files it under the publisher 北九州市. Its tags are 補助金, 集約. It offers 18 resource(s) in pdf, xlsx. The portal shows 2025-03-28 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
